Call For Papers   [PDF version]   [Chinese version]

The 2026 First International Conference on Biohybrid Robotics (ICBR 2026) will be held in China, from October 30 to November 1, 2026. ICBR 2026 is established in response to the transition from biomimetic and bioinspired robotics toward the functional integration of engineered systems with living organisms or their functional components. The conference aims to provide an international forum for researchers from fields of robotics, biomedical engineering, smart materials, neuroscience, intelligence and control, and related fields to share recent advances, discuss common challenges, and explore future directions at the interface of engineering and biology.

ICBR 2026 solicits submissions of original and high-quality research abstracts, tutorials and workshops in several topics including, but not limited to,

Design, fabrication, and integration of biohybrid robots;
Materials, interfaces and biocompatibility of biohybrid robots;
Modeling, actuation, sensing, and control of biohybrid robots;
Data fusion and intelligence of biohybrid robots;
Translational applications of multiscale biohybrid robotics;
Supportive technologies related to biohybrid robots.

Shanghai, one of China’s most dynamic and internationally connected cities, offers a unique blend of scientific innovation, cultural heritage, and modern urban experience. ICBR 2026 hopes and promises to be a great event for all participants with excellent technical and social programs.

Abstracts: Original abstracts are solicited. The submitted abstracts will not be peer-reviewed or be indexed by EI. All the accepted abstracts are required to be presented at the conference. The presentation type (oral presentation or poster presentation) will be determined and notified shortly after the final submission.

Tutorials & Workshops: Proposals are invited in the frontiers of emerging topics. All presentations will not be peer-reviewed, and do not appear in the proceedings.

Important Dates:
Submission of extended abstracts: Sep. 30, 2026 Oct. 23, 2026
Notification of acceptance: Oct. 5, 2026 Oct. 25, 2026
Final paper submission: Oct. 10, 2026 Oct. 27, 2026
Early bird registration: Oct. 15, 2026
All deadlines are 23:59 PST
